''See also: [[Sage of Red Faith Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of [[Red Faith]], also known as the [[Blood Sage]], is a powerful figure and the founder of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] cult. He is associated with [[Redmoon Hall]], an organization that utilizes red and black colors and features the image of a [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. Physically, he is described as having extremely pale skin and long white hair that reaches his feet, often appearing monochrome in contrast to the red elements of his path. He is known for using a series of daggers in combat and possesses advanced knowledge regarding the manipulation of [[blood madra]] and the cultivation of [[Blood Shadows]]. He has expressed disdain for those who use common, weak methods to raise their shadows, preferring more complex techniques. As a [[Sage]], he is characterized by his intellect and understanding, serving as the mind to the [[Redmoon Herald]]'s brute force. His role involves researching [[sacred arts]], mentoring students, and providing sponsorship to various practitioners within his sphere of influence. He has a history of conflict with other powerful entities, including the [[Redmoon Herald|Herald Redmoon]] and various other [[Sages]]. Despite his immense power and status, he has faced challenges regarding the cooperation of his own [[Blood Shadow]] and has engaged in high-stakes political and martial maneuvering alongside figures like [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This [[Blood Sage]] possesses the appearance of a frog. [[Red]] paint tracks down from his eyes.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Overlord and ally of [[Redmoon Hall]], this individual cooperates with [[Reigan Shen]] and will lead [[Calan Archer|Calan]]'s expedition. He harbors a hatred for [[Herald]] [[Remnants]] and has expressed curiosity regarding the rapid [[advancement]] of [[Eithan]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of [[Red Faith]] is the twin of [[Redmoon]] and maintains an alliance with [[Redmoon Hall]]. This Overlord acted as a teacher to [[Calan Archer]], whom they will lead on an expedition, and provided special instructions to [[Yan Shoumei]]. Additionally, the [[Sage]] cooperates with [[Reigan Shen]], uses memory sessions to learn from [[Yerin]], gifted a [[Divine Treasure]] to [[Sage of Calling Storms|Calling Storms]], and has expressed doubt regarding [[Eithan]]'s rapid [[advancement]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a [[Blood Sage]], he utilizes [[Blood aura|blood aura]], [[Shadow|shadow]], and [[cloud madra]]. His combat skills include using nine daggers in formation, and he possesses techniques for raising [[Blood Shadows]] as well as methods for feeding them [[dream aura]] and [[blood essence]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Overlord of shadows}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Sage]] of [[Red Faith]] is an Overlord who utilizes [[Shadow|shadow]] and [[cloud madra]] to prevent physical distractions within his laboratory.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref> To further his learning from [[Yerin]], he employs memory recording sessions.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11" /> He established a symbiotic relationship with a created [[Blood Shadow]], utilizing specific [[cycling]] patterns to provide the entity with [[blood essence]] and [[dream aura]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11" /> Because he produced a perfect copy rather than an imperfect one, he believes he failed to create a subordinate [[Blood Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11" /> This individual, who is the twin of [[Redmoon]], carves [[scripts]] into rings to conceal various locations.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref> Driven by a hatred for [[Herald]] [[Remnants]], he utilizes [[Blood aura|blood aura]] and fights with nine daggers in formation.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“This is a Heart’s Gem,” the Blood Sage said,<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Sage of Red Faith took a bloody finger from his mouth. “How did you advance so quickly? Even with our Monarch providing you with resources, it should have taken you much longer.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The man, an Overlord, didn’t flinch. “The Sage of Red Faith!”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" />}}
